leak_detector.L: sum over cohorts, block-days and hours of max(min(p_ch, p_dch), 0) x 1 h (MWh per representative day), from the hourly capture of the reproduced T8 (T8b beside)
beside: the conversion-loss form (1/eta_dch - eta_ch) x the primary
the row-dual implied value sum |dual| x max(p_ch, p_dch)/S_c^2 x m in ESSO objective units (sigma-scaled ADMM objective: not a EUR price, so not compared with the ceiling)
leak_detector.ceiling_rule: lambda.L priced <= 1 % of R/4, R = 10,000 EUR
leak_detector.horizon_weight: days[d] x years[y] of the ESSO (the real days a representative block-day stands for), discounted by 1/(1 + r)^(y - y0), r = the TN discount factor (the production planning weight)
leak_detector.price_primary: the TN expected day-ahead energy price of that block-day and hour (sum_m prob_m cost_energy_p[m][t], SRP1 case): a EUR/MWh price directly comparable with the EUR ceiling; applied to the whole leak L (an upper bound: the leak destroys only (1/eta_dch - eta_ch) = 7.2 % of L as conversion loss)

not_permitted: production or harness edits (the harness module is imported unedited)

T8-B1.operational: for every active cohort row with value >= 0.9999e-4: dual imported and |dual| > 0, and min |dual| over those rows >= 100 x max |dual| over the active rows with value <= 0.5e-4 (an interior-point method gives every inequality a positive multiplier mu/slack; the separation is what distinguishes a binding row); held per case (T8, T8b)
T8-B1.statement: the complementarity row dual is nonzero at every hour where the row value is >= 0.9999e-4

T8-B2.criterion: bitwise (the frozen record stores full float repr, so it supports bitwise); rel <= 1e-9 recorded beside; T8b likewise (informational)

T8-B3.operational: the set of (cohort, block-day) with a binding row (value >= 0.9999e-4) is exactly the 2025 cohort on the 8 multi-cohort block-days (2030 and 2035 x 4 days), and on each the binding periods are exactly {1, 2, 3, 4} (0-based period index, the p_req charge periods); the share of L in periods 1-4 is reported beside (expected ~0.8 from the frozen 4.85 / 4.69 hour-equivalents)

T9-F.statement: rows-off feasibility_penalty == the frozen after value within 1e-9 abs (the dispatch does not enter the objective; the v2 -> after penalty change is the closure-slack constant alone)

T9-R.mechanism_if_held: the three tests have a flat objective in the free dispatch (objective = the feasibility penalty, identical up to the closure-slack constant); IPOPT returns the barrier (analytic) centre of the degenerate optimal face; rows 6b/6c add barrier terms (and, at the t_ii_b / t_iv_peak discharge box, a near-active sum row), which moves that centre
T9-R.statement: with the two new row families deactivated, each undiagnosed quantity returns to its v2 value within 5 % of its v2 -> after change: the change is caused by rows 6b/6c, the closure-slack removal contributing <= 5 %

a.other_periods_of_the_day: free (so the daily closure can be met)

b.other_periods_of_the_day: free (periods 0-5: pre-charge window chosen by the solver)

t_iii.profile_rule: swing = (0.5-0.1) * f * sum_c E_cal(c) with E_cal = E_rated * phi^(n*k) (calendar-only end-of-block, an upper bound on E_av); phases at rate_mw from period 0, each on a new period, last partial: discharge swing*eta_dch, charge 2*swing/eta_ch, discharge swing*eta_dch; every other period 0; all periods fixed

t_iv.control: every period of the day fixed 0 (no peak)
t_iv.peak_rule: peak = midpoint of no_transfer_max = sum_c min(s_c, 0.4*E_cal_c*eta_dch) and with_transfer_max = min(s_A, 0.4*E_A*eta_dch) + min(s_B, (0.4*E_B + gain)*eta_dch), gain = max(0, 0.4*E_A - s_A/eta_dch)*eta_dch*eta_ch (A = 2025 cohort, B = 2030 cohort, calendar-only E); periods before the peak fixed 0, after the peak free (recharge to the closure)
